# Anoop Sinkaran
Blacktown NSW, Australia • 0406 295 160 • ns.anoop@gmail.com • linkedin.com/in/anoop-sinkaran

## Professional Summary
Seasoned Quality Assurance and Test Lead with over 19 years of software testing experience, offering proven expertise leading teams and managing end-to-end test execution across cloud platforms, enterprise systems, and distributed architectures. Demonstrated track record driving comprehensive test planning and strategy, defect triage governance, cross-functional stakeholder management, and migration testing from legacy platforms to modern cloud applications while safeguarding data integrity. Adept at establishing quality gates, designing high-coverage test cases, and integrating automated CI/CD pipelines to deliver resilient enterprise solutions.

## Technical Skills & Core Competencies
- **Leadership & Governance:** Test Planning & Strategy, End-to-End Testing Execution, Test Defect Management, Stakeholder Management, Cross-Functional Release Management, Defect Triage & Prioritization, Quality Gates, Dual BA/QA Requirements Ownership
- **Testing Methodologies & Validation:** Migration Testing, Data Integrity Validation, Reporting Validation, Test Case Design & Creation, System Integration Testing, Agile/Scrum
- **Cloud & Operating Environments:** Cloud Platforms, Azure DevOps Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Android Terminal Architecture, Enterprise Systems
- **Test Automation Tools & Frameworks:** Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, Android Espresso, iOS XCUITest, Robolectric, API Gateway Testing, MobSF
- **Programming & Scripting Languages:** C#, Java, Kotlin, Python, SQL, UNIX Shell Scripting, JavaScript, TypeScript, .NET, React
- **Test Management & Monitoring:** JIRA, Zephyr, TestRail, HP ALM, Dynatrace

- Engineered automated regression pipelines within Azure DevOps and integrated Mobile Security Framework (MobSF) for static code analysis to accelerate release governance.
